title: Tech Companies Boost Performance with Alliance Partner Award Winners | NetSuite
content:
This fourth post in a blog series showcases our 2024 Alliance Partner High-Tech Award winners in categories including AI and robotics; advertising, media, and publishing; software and technology; telecommunications; and services. With NetSuite and our Alliance Partners, high-tech companies have jumpstarted their journeys to success and, for some, an IPO or acquisition.

## Customer: 4AG Robotics

## AI/Robotics Spotlight Award Winner: Beyond Cloud [...] 4AG Robotics is transforming mushroom harvesting with innovative robotic solutions powered by AI and computer vision. These robotic solutions allow mushroom farms to automate today’s harvesting activities that are manual, tedious, and hindered by high employee turnover. 4AG Robotics' advanced robots are precise and efficient, capable of harvesting mushrooms at peak ripeness in smarter, longer and in reliable ways than human harvesters. The market leader in North America, Europe and Australia, [...] and Australia, 4AG Robotics is leading the way in modern mushroom farming and paving the path for a sustainable future in food production.
